short_description: AI chat that works offline on your phone, with optional cloud.
full_description:
AGI is an AI assistant that runs on your phone first.

LOCAL MODE
• Chat with an on-device model, even offline or in airplane mode
• No account needed; local chats stay on this device, encrypted at rest
• The default model downloads once and runs locally after that

AGI CLOUD (optional, sign-in)
• Cloud chat and web search on the Free plan
• Image generation on Pro and above
• Plans and credit top-ups are sold as in-app purchases

PRIVACY
• Cloud messages go to the AI provider that serves the request
• Choose which models may be used in Settings > Privacy
• Export or delete your data any time in Settings
• India DPDP notice and open items: https://agiworkforce.com/trust

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.
Support: support@agiworkforce.com
Privacy: https://agiworkforce.com/privacy
Terms: https://agiworkforce.com/terms

content_rating.iarc_rating: Teen (expected), with Diverse Content: Discretion Advised
content_rating.note: Mirrors ChatGPT and Claude on Google Play (both Teen, Diverse Content: Discretion Advised, checked 2026-10-19). AI output is not fixed content, so answer the IARC questions for the most mature output the filters allow, not the median reply.

target_audience.note: 13+ is the lowest age the binary admits. getAgeThreshold in apps/mobile/src/features/auth/services/ageGate.ts takes the larger of the device time zone's regional age (18 for India and Brazil, 16 for EU member-state zones and North Macedonia, 13 for the United Kingdom and every other zone) and ACCOUNT_MINIMUM_AGE (13, packages/contracts/types/src/account-eligibility.ts), so Cloud sign-in asks for 18 in India and Brazil, 16 in those EU zones and 13 everywhere else, and every band from 13 up is declared. An age under the device's threshold is refused and puts the install into one-way minor-safe mode, which filters every outgoing prompt against a shared blocklist before it reaches any model and cannot be switched off from inside the app.

data_collected_types.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud.
Only if provided by the user's sign-in method when signing in to AGI Cloud.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.
Only in AGI Cloud: photos attached to a message or set as the account avatar are uploaded.
Only in AGI Cloud: documents attached to a message are uploaded.

Only during live voice mode in an AGI Cloud chat: the microphone is streamed to AGI Cloud for the session and the transcript is saved to that chat. Dictation transcribes on the device and uploads no audio.
Only after sign-in: the account identifier carried by every authenticated cloud request.
Only after the user enables push notifications: an app-generated device UUID is registered with the push token. No advertising identifier is collected.

Only in AGI Cloud and only after the user allows product analytics in Settings, Privacy (off by default; a workspace administrator can also turn it off): event names such as a stopped or regenerated response, recorded against the account. No message, file or file name is included. Local Mode sends none.

data_safety.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends. Every type is optional because Cloud sign-in is optional: a signed-out user who has completed onboarding lands in Local Mode and is never redirected to a sign-in wall (apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx). The ground fact behind the sharing answer, stated plainly: in Cloud mode the user's messages and attachments leave the device, reach AGI Cloud, and are forwarded server-side to the model provider serving the request. 'Data shared' is answered false on the service-provider basis, the model, storage, auth and push subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors process that data on AGI's behalf, not for their own purposes. What the source tree proves: every outbound request from the device goes to an AGI-controlled host (apps/mobile/lib/constants.ts) plus Clerk for sign-in and the push service, so no third party receives data directly from the device; and apps/mobile/package.json declares no analytics, crash-reporting or ad SDK (no Sentry, Firebase, Crashlytics, Amplitude, PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Bugsnag or Datadog), so no telemetry stream leaves for a third party's own purposes. Whether Play's service-provider exception covers each subprocessor is a contractual question the repo cannot settle; it rests on the data-processing terms behind that subprocessor list. store-listing/android/data-safety.json declares the same types with the same sharing and optionality answers, the two files no longer disagree, and REVIEWER-NOTES-ANDROID.md records the same reconciliation for the Play reviewer.

in_app_products.note: The Android binary sells four auto-renewing subscriptions (Basic, Pro, Max 5x, Max 20x, each with one monthly base plan) and four consumable credit top-ups through Google Play Billing; product IDs, base plan IDs and prices are listed in docs/runbooks/mobile-store-products.md. Whether an account can buy is decided by the server on each request: the catalog must be enabled, Play product IDs registered, and the account must hold upgrade access while paid upgrades open in stages. Provide Play Review a signed-in account with upgrade access or an access code. Billing always shows Restore purchases, and configured products remain eligible for receipt verification when new sales are switched off. This repository cannot prove current live deployment or Play Console state; test purchase, restore, renewal, refund, plan change and pending payments with Play test purchases before submission. The binary links expo-iap; the server owner is mobile-iap-catalog.ts and the deployment flag is MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED. When the deployment flag is off, the catalog reason is "Native purchases are not enabled for this deployment." On iOS without registered products it is "App Store products have not been registered for this build." On Android without registered products it is "Google Play products have not been registered for this build." The Billing screen can show "Loading native purchases" and "Workspace administration" before or alongside its store status.

release_notes_v0_0_1:
AGI 0.0.1, first release.

• On-device AI chat works offline, no account needed
• Catalog-selected on-device model downloads once and runs locally
• Sign in to AGI Cloud for cloud chat and web search on the free tier; image generation on Pro and above
• On-device voice transcription
